purpose: Matched E0/E1 direct-target test of the SD3-derived relative resolution shift on MiniMax H3, isolated from progressive/trajectory guidance.

model_chain.keep: existing DiffAid -> Untwist -> Spectrum MODEL chain, then H3RuntimeMetricsProbe, then H3 Continuum Sampler V3.4

insert.placement: between the SA-Solver scheduler SIGMAS output and H3 Continuum Sampler V3.4 SIGMAS input

reference_basis.source_role: analytic H3-Base/native resolution regime; no source-resolution pass is executed
reference_basis.official_basis: H3-Base is documented as 768p and H3 output shorter side defaults to 768 px
reference_basis.aspect_matching: 896x928 target projected to 768px short side, then snapped to 32px VAE+DiT alignment -> 768x800

runs.invariant: Resolution-Aware Sigmas output must be bit-exact equal to its input SIGMAS.

expected_structure.note: Actual H3 NFE / Spectrum forecast split may differ between E0 and E1 because sigma coordinates change.
expected_structure.sa_solver_timing: Default tau window stays tied to effective supplied sigma; remapping may move which outer indices are stochastic without changing any sampler widget.
expected_structure.resolution_event: exactly one resolution_sigma_map event per graph execution with mode/factor/effective shift/sigma delta

decision_rule.before_decoding: Do not tune strength or calibrated_factor.
decision_rule.if_positive: Only then test the same remap combined with accepted D10 progressive+temporal.
decision_rule.if_neutral_or_negative: Leave resolution-aware sigmas experimental/off; do not start a strength sweep from this pair.

metrics_probe.placement: after Spectrum and before H3 Continuum Sampler V3.4
metrics_probe.purpose: passive model/sampler-call telemetry only; no capture, guidance, progressive, or attention behavior

output.metrics: connect to both H3ResolutionAwareSigmas.metrics and H3MetricsJSON.metrics
output.autosave: retain the same metrics JSON capture used by D10
